company.fiscal_year: 52 或 53 周财年，截至 12 月最后一个星期六；季度末落在自然季度末前后数日

income_usd_m._note: Each quarter from the 10-Q that first reported it (XBRL); Q4 = 10-K year minus the Q3 10-Q nine months. EPS and shares for Q4 are the 10-K's own three-month facts where tagged, otherwise left as read.

non_gaap_printed._note: First print = the quarter's own earnings release summary table; reprint = the year-ago column of the release four quarters later. They differ only where Intel changed its non-GAAP definitions between the two releases.

guidance._note: Revenue is the GAAP revenue outlook: a point ± US$500M in 2016Q1-2018Q3 (stored as the range), a single 'approximately' figure in 2018Q4-2022Q2 (lo == hi), a range from 2022Q3. In 2016Q1 and 2021Q1-Q4 the non-GAAP revenue outlook differed (Altera deferred revenue; NAND excluded) and is kept beside it. Gross margin was guided only in 2016Q1-2017Q4 (± a couple of points) and from 2021Q2 (a point); 2018Q1-2021Q1 guided operating margin instead. EPS was first guided for 2017Q1. Every value was also found in the same release's GAAP-to-non-GAAP outlook reconciliation table.

cash_flow_usd_m._note: OCF, dividends and buybacks are each quarter's cash-flow statement as filed (year-to-date differenced; the release-printed OCF equals it in all 36 quarters that print one). Gross capex, government incentives and partner contributions (net of distributions) prefer the three-month figure the company printed: the quarter's own release, else the next year's release's year-ago column, else the statement as filed (investing plus financing additions to PP&E) in the next year's 10-Q comparative column, else as first filed. Adjusted free cash flow is printed from 2022Q1 only; its definition was reworded several times.

balance_sheet_usd_m._note: Each quarter-end from that quarter's 10-Q/10-K balance sheet, and equal in every one of 416 line-quarters to the balance sheet in the same quarter's earnings release. From 2022 Intel folds its non-current marketable debt investments into short-term investments; the Dec 2021 year-end restated in later filings adds US$840M that this series, as first filed, leaves out.

foundry_external.what_it_is: 公司口径的外部收入是 Intel Foundry 向外部客户的代工与封装测试收入合计，10-Q 分部附注原文是「third-party foundry and assembly and test revenues from external customers」。
foundry_external.source: 外部收入取自各季 10-Q 与 10-K 分部附注（第四季度为全年减前三季）；Altera 的份额取自 10-Q 投资附注里 Altera 一段的关联方收入。
foundry_external._note: Current basis (Q1 2025 recast) from 2024Q1. The 2024 filings printed 27/77/67/214 for the same four quarters before the recast; the filings do not say what moved (the reader's inference is IMS leaving the segment).

restatement_events.what: 采用 ASU 2017-07，把养老金成本移出销货成本与营业费用并追溯重述上一年
restatement_events.quote: Operating expenses and interest and other, net have been retrospectively restated due to the adoption of ASU 2017-07 in the first quarter of 2018.

restatement_events.what: non-GAAP 剔除待售的 NAND 业务，同比的上年数一并剔除
restatement_events.quote: Non-GAAP results and business outlook exclude the NAND memory business, which is subject to a pending divestiture. Year-over-year comparisons also exclude NAND from 2020 results.

restatement_events.what: non-GAAP 起剔除股权激励与全部股权投资损益
restatement_events.quote: Starting in the first quarter of 2022, we incrementally exclude from our non-GAAP results, share-based compensation and all gains and losses on equity investments.

restatement_events.what: non-GAAP 的所得税影响改按固定的长期预测税率计算
restatement_events.quote: Beginning in 2023, income tax effects are calculated using the same fixed long-term projected tax rate across all adjustments.
